title: Porta Genova
body: A linear park along the former Porta Genova rail yard in Milan, running from the street down to the Naviglio. The old goods shed is kept and reopened as a market hall, with a colonnade added along its length.
The park is organized as a sequence of rooms — a sculpture court, a lawn with an open-air screen, growing houses among the planting beds, a pine grove — ending at steps down to the water.
